events.name: Trapped Chest
events.description: A heavy iron chest sits in the corner. It looks valuable... and suspicious.

success.description: You find and disarm a poison dart trap! The chest contains treasure.

failure.description: You don't notice the trap. A dart shoots out as you open the chest!

choices.description: A dart shoots out and hits you! But at least the treasure is yours.
Sometimes the best treasure is the one you don't open.

events.name: Undead Ambush
events.description: The walls groan and crack. Skeletal hands burst from the stonework!

events.name: Mysterious Fountain
events.description: A fountain of shimmering liquid stands in the center of this room. The liquid changes color as you watch.

choices.description: The liquid tastes of mint and starlight. Your wounds close.
Fire courses through your veins! You feel powerful.
The liquid tastes awful. Your stomach churns.

events.name: Cave-In!
events.description: The ceiling groans ominously. Dust rains down and then — CRASH!

success.description: You roll out of the way as tons of rubble crash down behind you.

failure.description: Rocks pummel you before you can escape!

events.name: Ghostly Warning
events.description: A translucent figure materializes before you. It points deeper into the dungeon and whispers...

success.description: The ghost reveals the location of traps and enemies ahead.

failure.description: The ghost's whispers are incomprehensible. It fades away.

success.description: The ghost bows and dissipates. A gold coin materializes where it stood.

failure.description: The ghost shrieks in anger. You feel a cold chill!

events.name: Hidden Treasure Room
events.description: Behind a crumbling wall, you discover a forgotten treasure room! Gold coins and dusty gems litter the floor.

events.name: Slime!
events.description: The floor squelches underfoot. What you thought was a puddle of water begins to move...
